name: Macy's Credit Card

base_rate.description: 2 points per $1 at Macy's for Silver members (3 for Gold, 5 for Platinum).

categories.label: Macy's purchases, Gold status ($500 to $1,199 annual Macy's card spend)
Macy's purchases, Platinum status ($1,200+ annual Macy's card spend)

rewards.redemption_notes: 1,000 points = $10 in Star Money, usable on anything at Macy's except gift cards, services and fees.

signup_bonus.description: 30% off macys.com purchases the day the card is opened (in-store discount varies), up to $100.

notes: Closed-loop Macy's store card issued through Citi; usable only at Macy's, so network is other. New cards open at Silver status. APR is not shown on the product page.
